sentences.pt: Rafael não sabe cozinhar muito bem.
sentences.en: Rafael doesn't know how to cook very well.

sentences.pt: Mas, no sábado, os pais da namorada dele, Beatriz, vão jantar na casa dele.
sentences.en: But on Saturday, the parents of his girlfriend, Beatriz, are going to have dinner at his house.

sentences.pt: Ele quer fazer um jantar gostoso para eles.
sentences.en: He wants to make a delicious dinner for them.

sentences.pt: Então ligou para a avó e pediu a receita de frango assado dela.
sentences.en: So he called his grandmother and asked for her roast chicken recipe.

sentences.pt: — É simples — disse a avó. — Você precisa de frango, alho, cebola, azeite e sal.
sentences.en: "It's simple," said his grandmother. "You need chicken, garlic, onion, olive oil and salt."

sentences.pt: No sábado à tarde, Rafael foi ao supermercado e comprou tudo.
sentences.en: On Saturday afternoon, Rafael went to the supermarket and bought everything.

sentences.pt: Comprou também batatas, verduras para uma salada e sorvete para a sobremesa.
sentences.en: He also bought potatoes, greens for a salad and ice cream for dessert.

sentences.pt: Em casa, ele cortou a cebola e o alho e misturou com azeite e sal.
sentences.en: At home, he cut the onion and the garlic and mixed them with olive oil and salt.

sentences.pt: Depois, colocou o frango temperado e as batatas para assar.
sentences.en: Then he put the seasoned chicken and the potatoes in to roast.

sentences.pt: Enquanto o frango assava, ele lavou a alface e os tomates.
sentences.en: While the chicken was roasting, he washed the lettuce and the tomatoes.

sentences.pt: Às sete horas, Beatriz e os pais chegaram.
sentences.en: At seven o'clock, Beatriz and her parents arrived.

sentences.pt: O pai dela provou o frango e não disse nada.
sentences.en: Her father tasted the chicken and didn't say anything.

sentences.pt: Rafael ficou nervoso.
sentences.en: Rafael got nervous.

sentences.pt: Então o pai colocou mais frango no prato.
sentences.en: Then her father put more chicken on his plate.

sentences.pt: — Está muito gostoso! Quem te ensinou? — ele perguntou.
sentences.en: "It's delicious! Who taught you?" he asked.

sentences.pt: — A minha avó — respondeu Rafael, aliviado.
sentences.en: "My grandmother," answered Rafael, relieved.

sentences.pt: A mãe de Beatriz achou a comida um pouco salgada, mas comeu tudo.
sentences.en: Beatriz's mother found the food a little salty, but she ate everything.

sentences.pt: Na sobremesa, todos tomaram sorvete de chocolate e café.
sentences.en: For dessert, everyone had chocolate ice cream and coffee.

sentences.pt: No fim da noite, a mãe de Beatriz pediu a receita também.
sentences.en: At the end of the evening, Beatriz's mother asked for the recipe too.

questions.q: Quem deu a receita para Rafael?
O que a mãe de Beatriz achou da comida?
questions.qEn: What did Beatriz's mother think of the food?

sentences.pt: Larissa e Patrícia são amigas desde a escola.
sentences.en: Larissa and Patrícia have been friends since school.

sentences.pt: No domingo, elas foram almoçar em um restaurante perto da praia, em Fortaleza.
sentences.en: On Sunday, they went to have lunch at a restaurant near the beach, in Fortaleza.

sentences.pt: O restaurante estava cheio, e elas esperaram quinze minutos por uma mesa.
sentences.en: The restaurant was full, and they waited fifteen minutes for a table.

sentences.pt: O garçom trouxe o cardápio e dois copos de água gelada.
sentences.en: The waiter brought the menu and two glasses of cold water.

sentences.pt: Patrícia estava com muita fome e queria provar tudo.
sentences.en: Patrícia was very hungry and wanted to try everything.

sentences.pt: — Eu quero o peixe com arroz e feijão — disse ela.
sentences.en: "I want the fish with rice and beans," she said.

sentences.pt: Larissa tem alergia a pimenta, então perguntou ao garçom:
sentences.en: Larissa is allergic to chili pepper, so she asked the waiter:

sentences.pt: — O frango com legumes é picante?
sentences.en: "Is the chicken with vegetables spicy?"

sentences.pt: — Não, senhora, mas o cozinheiro pode fazer sem pimenta — ele respondeu.
sentences.en: "No, ma'am, but the cook can make it without pepper," he answered.

sentences.pt: Para beber, elas pediram um suco de laranja e um refrigerante.
sentences.en: To drink, they ordered an orange juice and a soda.

sentences.pt: A comida demorou um pouco, mas estava muito gostosa.
sentences.en: The food took a while, but it was very tasty.

sentences.pt: O peixe estava bem temperado, e o frango estava macio.
sentences.en: The fish was well seasoned, and the chicken was tender.

sentences.pt: Depois do almoço, elas dividiram uma fatia de bolo de chocolate.
sentences.en: After lunch, they shared a slice of chocolate cake.

sentences.pt: Quando a conta chegou, Patrícia ficou surpresa.
sentences.en: When the bill came, Patrícia was surprised.

sentences.pt: O total era cento e vinte reais, mais a gorjeta do garçom.
sentences.en: The total was one hundred and twenty reais, plus the waiter's tip.

sentences.pt: — Está um pouco caro — disse Patrícia.
sentences.en: "It's a bit expensive," said Patrícia.

sentences.pt: — Mas a comida foi ótima, e olhe o mar! — respondeu Larissa.
sentences.en: "But the food was great, and look at the sea!" answered Larissa.

sentences.pt: Elas dividiram a conta e pagaram com cartão.
sentences.en: They split the bill and paid by card.

sentences.pt: Depois, foram andar na areia e tomar um sorvete.
sentences.en: Then they went to walk on the sand and have an ice cream.

sentences.pt: Patrícia riu: — A gente nunca para de comer!
sentences.en: Patrícia laughed: "We never stop eating!"

questions.q: Por que Larissa perguntou sobre o frango?
questions.qEn: Why did Larissa ask about the chicken?
options: Porque ela tem alergia a pimenta

questions.q: Quanto foi a conta, sem a gorjeta?
questions.qEn: How much was the bill, without the tip?

questions.q: O que elas fizeram depois do almoço?
questions.qEn: What did they do after lunch?
